note: Both sets contain the same four core facts (KP, KI, KD at θ = 0º and ζφ = 0.7), each duplicated with only cosmetic entity-name variants, so neither adds real coverage. Set A's damping-ratio claim keeps the meaningful condition (used to compensate for neglecting negative damping from the generator-torque controller), which is directly supported by the text. Set B instead offers a claim whose 'condition' is merely the symbol name (zeta_phi), which is trivial and misuses the condition field. Otherwise the values, units and quotes are faithful in both sets.
